issues.description: The template defines the number of classical bits for the Exercise 4 circuit as a string instead of an integer. In template_repository/ex4_grover_lights_out_puzzle.py the field self.number_of_bits_classical_register is initialized to the string "0" which will cause errors when constructing a ClassicalRegister and is inconsistent with the solution (which uses an integer 4). This is a structural type error in the template that will block students from instantiating the circuit as-is and is not an intentional pedagogical gap.
issues.suggestedFix: Change self.number_of_bits_classical_register in the template to an integer placeholder (e.g. 0) instead of the string "0", or initialize it to the intended default integer value. For example: self.number_of_bits_classical_register = 0  ### FILL IN NUMBER OF BITS ###. This makes the template type-consistent with the solution and allows students to construct the ClassicalRegister without type errors.
